transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in today because... the thought of getting on an airplane right now just scares me so bad. I mean, I know it doesn't really make sense, but my body just tells me that the plane is going to fall.
Have you ever had a sudden panic attack when you were not on or about to board an airplane?
No, I haven't. It's really just the airplanes. If I'm not flying or thinking about having to fly, I feel fine. I don't get those panic attacks any other time.
